newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: SOCCER-DEFENDERS GIVE PARAGUAY 2-1 WIN OVER CHILE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEFENDERS GIVE PARAGUAY 2-1 WIN OVER CHILE.

text.p: Paraguay, who drew away to Argentina last month thanks to a goal by their goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, beat Chile 2-1 in a World Cup qualifier on Wednesday with both goals coming from their central defenders.

The result put Paraguay fourth in the single nine-team South American group and, with a win away to Uruguay already under their belts, they look a good bet to reach the World Cup finals for the first time since 1986.
Chile were left in seventh place with only one win in four outings, although they have played three of their matches away.
Paraguay, backed by a 40,000 crowd in their notoriously intimidating Defensores del Chaco stadium, took the game to their opponents early on and wasted four clearcut chances in the first 20 minutes.
They paid dearly when Chilean defender Javier Margas headed his side ahead with their first decent attack in the 22nd minute.
Two minutes later, central defender Carlos Gamarra abandoned his defensive duties and shot the home side back on level terms.
Paraguay's reward for their pressure came in the 63rd minute when Catalino Rivarola, Gamarra's partner at the heart of the defence, scored the winner.

Paraguay - Jose Luis Chilavert, Celso Ayala, Catalino Rivarola, Carlos Gamarra, Francisco Arce, Roberto Acuna, Julio Enciso (Richard Baez (65th minute), Estanislao Struway, Mauro Caballero (Aristides Rojas 46th), Miguel Benitez, Jose Cardozo (Jorge Alcarez 68th).

Chile - Marcelo Ramirez, Pedro Reyes, Ronald Fuentes, Javier Margas (Fabian Estay, 80th), Christian Castaneda, Marcelo Miranda, Luis Musrri, Fernando Cornejo, Jorge Contreras (Sebastian Rosenthal, 55th), Ivan Zamorano, Fernando Vergara (Rodrigo Goldberg, 75th).
